value.rationale: The Fano incidence graph is the canonical smallest toroidal cubic girth-six example. Its perfect matching transition dynamics via any alternating hexagon unexpectedly realize a known highly symmetric distance-regular graph, while natural surface-face-only dynamics break into 3K1+3C7. This explains structurally why nonfacial trades affect reachability and gives a complete natural exact benchmark with a canonical Coxeter interpretation, rather than a cosmetic numerical slice.
